items.title: PAYDAY 3 X Tom Clancy’s Ghost Recon Crimebond Teaser
items.excerpt: Legendary Tom Clancy’s Ghost Recon gear and weapons will infiltrate PAYDAY 3 in a brand new Crimebond, coming November 24.

items.title: A message to our players from Starbreeze CEO Adolf Kristjansson (a.k.a. AK)
items.excerpt: Last weekend, more than 320,000 of you jumped into PAYDAY 3, with 250,000 of you putting the mask on for the first time. The rest of you came back, and we couldn't be more delighted.

items.title: PAYDAY 3: Double Infamy Event
items.excerpt: Gain double the amount of Infamy Points this weekend in PAYDAY 3!

items.title: PAYDAY 3 Free Weekend & Sale Event
items.excerpt: Between November 5th and November 9th, play PAYDAY 3 for FREE! Plus, buy the game & DLCs for a steal with sale discounts!

items.title: PAYDAY 3: Update 3.10.1 Changelog
items.excerpt: We are now rolling out a new Hotfix to address some of the issues that came up with the 3.10 Update.

items.title: PAYDAY 3: Guns Blazin’ Crimebond Now Available!
items.excerpt: The Guns Blazin' Crimebond contains outfits, cosmetics, weapon perks, and, for the first time in PAYDAY 3, dual revolvers and (stealable) dual shotguns.

items.title: PAYDAY 3: Update 3.10 Changelog
items.excerpt: Today's update features a new Crimebond, the Feeding Frenzy Heist, Headless Nebula Accounts, Arges Perk Updates, and more!

items.title: PAYDAY 3: Behind the Scenes with Andrej #9
items.excerpt: October is almost over! And Andrej is finally back with another update on what the team has been working on for PAYDAY 3!

items.title: PAYDAY 3: The Future of PAYDAY with Paul – Episode 5
items.excerpt: As we approach the end of the year, Paul is back to share what’s coming in October, November, and December!
